references.text: Jacob's blessing over Asher in Genesis: 'Asher—his bread shall be rich, and he shall yield royal delicacies.' Both texts speak of Asher's wealth and abundance.
The description of the tribe of Asher's inheritance in Canaan included fertile areas known for olive production, which explains the reference to dipping one's foot in oil.
The birth of Asher and his naming: Leah said, 'Happy am I!' The name Asher means 'happy' or 'blessed,' reflecting the blessing in Deuteronomy.
Job describes his former prosperity: 'when my feet bathed in cream and the rock beside me poured out streams of oil.' A similar imagery of abundance and blessing.
The census of the tribe of Asher in the wilderness shows that the tribe was numerous and blessed, consistent with the blessing in Deuteronomy.
